headline: House passes trade deal and ethics investigations surge as Congress battles over business regulations and character questions!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on September 1, adjourning until September 4. No votes or legislative action took place.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed the AGOA Extension Act with strong bipartisan support (370-48) and approved multiple ethics-related resolutions, including finding two individuals in contempt for refusing to comply with ethics subpoenas. Georgia Rep. Everton Blair was sworn in, bringing the House to 432 members.
